DESIGN_NOTE: H HotpotQA 1k-dev substrate KB-ingest; mirrors n8 ConceptNet + U1 FB15k-237 chain-grade pattern. Per-item 2-hop chain: (title1, linked_via, title2) + (title2, supplies_answer, answer). Encoder: MiniLM-L6 (n8-proven on short entity names; chosen over pythia-160m mean-pool which collapsed on MedQA long vignettes). Encoder-geometry HALT guard (off-diag cos > 0.95) catches the MedQA signature pre-emptively. Fix #16 discriminator-regime: random-key control + frozen-encoder semantic baseline + 1-hop direct baseline (all <= 2x means HALT).
